records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to a report of a vehicle v. pedestrian crash. upon arrival, i met with p1 as well as three individuals who described themselves as friends, knowing p1 from the neighborhood. p1 had called from a residence approximately 2 blocks away from the incident location. p1 advised me of the following: approximately 30-40 minutes prior to my arrival, he was struck by a vehicle. he was walking w/[roadway], having just left a convenience store at san patricio / s trinity. he was holding a beer in his hand and was walking on the pavement since there is no sidewalk at this location. he was struck from behind by a gray vehicle on the left side of his body. the vehicle then continued on to a house nearby without stopping. he went to his friend's house a couple of blocks away. i asked p1 why he did not contact police right away, p1 did not have an explanation for this. p1's friend advised me she thought he was scared. p1 appeared to possible be intoxicated at the time i spoke with him and did say he had consumed alcohol. ofc. flores #1288 accompanied one of p1's friend's to a home nearby, where she made contact with d1. d1 advised ofc. flores of the following: he was involved in crash. he was exiting the parking lot at incident location and pulling onto san patricio. he 'bumped' p1 with his vehicle, and did not think p1 was injured. he exited his vehicle and checked on p1. p1 advised him he was ok. he advised p1 to be careful around vehicles and went home. he then walked over to where p1 had been located to apologize again, however as he approached p1, p1 began yelling at him, so he returned home. d1 did admit to striking p1 with his vehicle as he entered the roadway. d1 at fault due to improper turn. p1 had his vitals checked by safd sq08, and he was released for self care. he complained of left leg pain, but had no major injuries and no injuries requiring hospitalization at this time. i provided p1 with a courtesy ride to haven for hope per his request. coban/bwc available.

records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 was traveling east on [roadway] in the #3 lane of travel, approaching the intersection with n ih 35 svrd sb. as unit 1 approached the intersection the traffic light turned green and he proceed through the intersection. unit 2 was operating a bird electric scooter and was crossing [roadway] using the west north-south crosswalk at this intersection. unit 1's front end struck unit 2, the pedestrian on the scooter, and was flung a few feet away to the south east. i spoke with a witness on the scene, sabrina, who stated she was parked at the red light, in the #2 lane of [roadway]. she stated the pedestrian was following another group of scooters and that unit 1 failed to yeild to [roadway] and struck unit 2. officer valdez 6712, works in the departments halo unit and was able to observe the collision on [identifier] at 19:49:41. he updated the call text with the following: ""scooter user was heading sb on the svrd at 7th/ 35. the whi veh was heading eb on 7th #3 lane. the veh with the green light struck the rider into the intersection. the 2 other riders were not hit. all perties still 23. ems and afd 23""i spoke with two other riders, who were friends of unit 2's and they advised they still had time on the walk signal as unit 2 crossed [roadway]. the driver of unit 1, has a nexar branded dash cam system that i was able to review. it shows the collision. it shows unit 1 approaching the intersection, which does not appear to be speeding. the camera shows the light for eastbound traffic turn green, more than 3 seconds before unit 1 reaches the crosswalk. the camera also shows inside the vehicle and the driver did not appear to be distracted at the time of the collision or the moments leading up to it. i watched the lights cycle to ensure the pedestrian walk sign, showed do not walk while the eastbound traffic light was green. the pedetrain signal changes to do not walk, 4 seconds prior to the eastbound traffic light turning green.

records.public_safe_text: unit #1 was traveling in the parking lot of walmart at [roadway] in cedar hill. the driver of unit #1 stated he was making a left turn from parking aisle 6 [roadway] in front of [roadway]. while making the turn, the driver of unit #1 stated he was looking to his right to make sure no cars were coming and proceeded to make his left turn. he said as he was turning he looked back left and immediately struck a shopping cart full of groceries that he did not initially see. he stated he stopped the car and observed a woman running toward his car and pick up a small child from the ground on the front left side of the ground. the driver stated he did not know if he struck the child but assumed he did based on the reaction of the mother. officers on scene reviewed surveillance video from walmart showing the exit doors. the video shows the child walking quickly and exit the store next to her mother pushing the shopping cart. the child appears to go to the right while to the mother pushing the shopping cart goes to the left without holding the child's hand. the video shows the child walk across the pedestrian crossing in the parking lot when unit #1 strikes the shopping cart and knocks some groceries out of the cart. the video shows the child make it past front end of unit #1 and that is when the child is seen falling to the ground on the drivers side of unit #1. the video does not actually show the child being struck by the car, [roadway] the child fell and how the car was traveling, it is believed the child may have been struck by the side of unit #1 or the side mirror. the child sustained a minor bump on her left elbow as well as the left side of her head.

[roadway], half in the number 1 lane and half on the improved shoulder unit 3 was stopped. du1 stated that after u2 jumped from his vehicle, at which time he began to slow down and was attempting to block traffic from striking u2. du1 stated that while maneuvering his vehicle he was struck from the rear causing his vehicle to spin out. du4 stated he was in the number 4 lane and unit 1 [roadway]. du4 struggled to remember the details on the crash. du4 stated that while attempting to switch into the number 3 lane he saw a pedestrian in the roadway and took evasive action to not hit the pedestrian. du4 stated he swerved to the left where he saw unit 1 appear to be making a [roadway]. du4 stated he struck unit 1 on the front right area. du4 was checked out by ems and found not to be injured. on [roadway] officer rodriguez #1268 met with the driver of unit 3 (du3). officer rodriguez informed me that du3 stated she [roadway] when she saw a pedestrian in the roadway. du3 attempted evasive action by beginning to merge to the right when she saw u1 in front of her also merging towards the right. du3 stated she then took evasive action by moving to the left when she struck u1 from the rear. du3 was evaluated by ems at her request where ems found no signs on [medical facility] for safety at which time ems transported her to ne baptist. because u2 [roadway] and because du1 attempted to block traffic around u2, unit 3 and unit 4 crashed into u1. all involved vehicles were towed to growdon by city wreckers ([identifier], [identifier] [identifier]). officer garcia #[medical facility] where his non life threatening injuries were treated and he was placed under emergency detention. du1 and pu1 stayed with u2 in a ems unit. all involved parties were given the [case id] for this crash. i notified sgt. deleon #3219 of the details of this crash and of u2's emergency detention. bwc/coban available.

ems arrived to evaluate his injuries. i observed a cut to the back of u2's head (non life-threatening injuries). u2 would advise police on scene that he had 4-5 drinks at a neighboring bar and was
